tax_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) / ضريبة القيمة المضافة
legal_ref: VAT Law (Royal Decree M/113, 1438H), Art. 2 as amended by Royal Order A/638 (1441H); VAT Implementing Regulations
quote: VAT is imposed on all supplies in the Kingdom, most of which are subject to the standard rate of 15%. (ZATCA Retail Sector Guideline, Issue 3, May 2026). Effective date: "زيادة نسبة ضريبة القيمة المضافة إلى 15% اعتبارًا من 1 يوليو 2020م" — increase of the VAT rate to 15% from 1 July 2020 (ZATCA VAT 15% rate-change guideline, section 2)
source_title: ZATCA – Guideline for Retail Sector under VAT Provisions (Issue 3, May 2026); also ZATCA VAT 15% guideline https://zatca.gov.sa/ar/HelpCenter/guidelines/Documents/VAT15.pdf
notes: Single positive rate 15% (raised from 5% with effect from 1 July 2020; transitional rules for pre-11 May 2020 contracts ended 30 June 2021). Zero rate on exports, international transport, qualifying medicines and medical equipment, investment metals, etc.; exemptions for certain financial services and residential rent; real-estate disposals moved out of VAT into the separate 5% Real Estate Transaction Tax from 4 Oct 2020. Prices in retail must be displayed VAT-inclusive (15/115 fraction).
unverified: Text of Royal Order A/638 itself was not fetched; the 15%/1 July 2020 facts are taken from ZATCA guidelines
